The operator panels are SAM Simulator's photographs of the three columns (samsim_panels), at 1 mm per pixel: every control, lamp and screen sits where it is in those photos, cross-checked against real-cabin photos (cabin_photos) and the game's sprite positions. Distances between seats, the columns' height above the floor and the controls the game has no picture for are SAM3D estimates that only need to be reachable and readable. Lamp meanings follow the SAM Simulator manual where it gives them.

displays.label: SOC indicator
displays.notes: Search picture up to 45 km on the selected scale, with the SSC azimuth line and range gate the operator puts on the target mark (p22). Sweep period, afterglow, the 10-45 km scale drawn as a delayed sweep (centre = 10 km), the clutter disc and the gate marker are SAM3D estimates.

displays.label: Range indicator
displays.notes: Two sweeps: the upper shows 0-28 km with the target as a spike, the lower a 1.5 km magnification around the range gates. The counter shows the range wheel (p24 item 2). Sweeps appear 1 min after switching on, and the radar picture only with РАБОТА selected (voenizdat_osa_1991 p98–100, Fig. 2.36).

displays.label: βс
displays.notes: SSC azimuth in Russian military angle (60-00 = 360 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: SOC/SSC readout strip
displays.source: docs/research/OSA_MANUALS_2026-10.md (the strip: ΔД, Δε, β and ε of the tracking radar); cabin_photos (opisybroni 54539); cabin_photos (user_modernised_2 (eight counters); captions under them include ΔД, Δε, АЗИМУТ ССЦ, УГОЛ МЕСТА ССЦ, СВР I, II)
displays.notes: Left to right: ΔД (metres between the range gate and the echo in it), Δε (mils between the antenna's elevation and the echo's), the SSC azimuth rough then fine counter, the SSC elevation rough then fine counter, and the two СВР (missile channel) places, not read yet. Angles are in mils (6000 to the circle, XX-YY; samsim_osa p16): rough = the hundreds, fine = the rest. Which counter reads what, and what exactly the deviations are, is our reading of the manual's one-line description and the photographs.

displays.label: TOV monitor
displays.notes: The camera looks along the SSC azimuth and elevation with the wide or narrow lens; crosshair at the centre.

displays.label: εс
displays.notes: SSC elevation in Russian military angle (15-00 = 90 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: ДЦ
displays.notes: Measured target distance, 10 V = 10 km. Reads while the SSC tracks in range (the range wheel follows the target then); rests at 0 otherwise. Full scale 30 V: SAM3D estimate.
